title: Kinso launch (Your next deal is in here somewhere. Woah. You are a really busy person. Let's solve this first. Meet KINSO. One inbox for every conversation.)
arc: problem -> meet -> features -> cta: the pain is an object (a notification stack) that physically splits the word 'somewhere', a bouncing ball reads a sentence, the brand arrives as a colour gradient and logo, features are told through the UI growing from the previous line, a waitlist counter climbs, and the film closes on the logo and URL.
world: Soft peach-to-teal gradient mesh with white, glass white UI windows and black Inter-style type; a dark charcoal ground with hexagon grid appears only for the 'busy person' beat; a coral-orange accent (the orb, dot, highlights).
actor: A coral orb: it is a bouncing ball that reads 'You are a really busy person', the dot ahead of 'It learns', a big gradient orb the phone shrinks into, the ball behind the KINSO mark and the logo dot at the end.

lines.show: On the empty gradient, 'Your next deal' types and settles with a slight lift on the middle word before sitting small and centred.
lines.handoff: The line shifts left and the next words land at the same baseline at a larger size.

lines.show: 'is in here' replaces 'Your next deal' at a larger size; 'here' takes a coral-teal gradient fill, the only coloured word.
lines.handoff: 'here' scales up past the frame and blurs, becoming the stage for the next object.

lines.show: 'here' is blown up huge and blurred; a vertical white pill rises from the bottom edge through the middle of 'here' and fills with app icons (Gmail, Slack, WhatsApp, Instagram) each with a red count badge, building into a notification stack that splits the word into 'some' and 'where' so it reads 'some | where'.
lines.handoff: The stack tilts out of the word, rotating to horizontal as the word fades.

lines.show: The notification stack tilts through 45 degrees to horizontal, the icons sliding off the word and orbiting, the word blurring with it.
lines.handoff: The stack is flung onto a coral halftone burst.

lines.show: The horizontal white stack lands on a coral halftone circle; the four icons collapse into a red-dot 'o' that squeezes into an ellipse and a small dot, so the stack becomes a white label reading 'Woah' (W, red o, ah), which settles and shrinks.
lines.handoff: The label shrinks to centre, then a hard cut to dark.

lines.line: You are a really busy person
lines.show: A charcoal hexagon-grid ground; a small peach ball bounces in from the lower left and bounces along the line: each word is highlighted by the ball landing on it ('You are', 'a really', 'busy', 'person'), 'busy' and 'person' bold on a teal bar that the ball pushes, a karaoke ball.

lines.handoff: The bar folds into the outline logo on the gradient.

lines.handoff: A word fades in at the right of the mark.

lines.show: 'Meet' sits right of the logo mark at small size; the mark holds.
lines.handoff: The word is replaced in place by the wordmark.

lines.show: 'Meet' becomes 'KINSO' in black wordmark next to a refined mark (two rounded brackets).

lines.handoff: The window slides to the left; a coral dot and text appear at the right.

lines.line: Email has requested sales contract. I have found a related email where you have sent the contract.

lines.line: It drafts replies that sound like you

lines.handoff: Selection handles appear round the bar, which then warps into a draft card.

lines.handoff: The card slides up and out; the counter replaces it.

lines.show: A tiny 'Join 30' counter climbs 3,946, 12,743, 21,603 to 27,300 in a quarter-second per step with digits rolling; 'others' stays small, the number bolder.
lines.handoff: The sentence grows to full width.

lines.show: 'on the waitlist' appears huge in white on charcoal, sliding left until 'waitlist' alone fills the frame; letters stretch and warp horizontally as a transition.
lines.handoff: A circular white iris with pinwheel shards wipes the frame.

lines.show: The warped word is eaten by a circle that opens as a pinwheel of white shards, then a coral orb appears on a gradient.
lines.handoff: The orb shrinks into the logo mark.

lines.show: A small logo mark appears centred on the gradient; 'kinso.ai' types in at its right in tiny black type; held to the end.
lines.handoff: End hold.

techniques: object splits the word (notification stack through 'somewhere')
stack becomes the label 'Woah' (object to type)
UI window grows out of the caption
counter roll then oversize word wipe
lessons: Make the problem a physical object entering the line: the notification stack splitting 'somewhere' says more than the word does.
Convert one object into the next beat's type (stack to 'Woah' label) so the handoff carries meaning.
Use a bouncing ball to read the one line you want people to feel ('You are a really busy person').
Grow the product UI out of the caption that introduces it so the line and the window are one object.
Pair each feature sentence with one visible UI behaviour: highlight steps down the list for 'ranks', a phone panel for 'WhatsApp', typing in the input for 'drafts'.
Land the CTA with a number that counts up, then blow the key word up to full frame, then settle to the logo and URL.
